description: Road Safety Enforcement Data is a collection of resources listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Road Safety Data Hub and Analytics. The road safety enforcement data provides summary series of road safety enforcement activities undertaken across the Australian states and territories from 2008. The road safety enforcement data series is provided annually by state and territory police agencies and state revenue offices to the Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics (BITRE). Coverage is Australia, 2008 to 2024; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2025-08-25. Files and pages listed: CSV, PDF (5 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
